description: This file defines the SplashActivity class for an Android application. It manages the display of a branded splash screen during app startup using the Android 12+ SplashScreen API with fallback handling for earlier Android versions. The activity handles timing to show the splash for 3 seconds, maintains visual consistency with background color and text, and navigates to the MainActivity after the splash duration.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: Main activity responsible for displaying a branded splash screen and transitioning to the main app screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash screen, sets up timing for display duration, and manages transition to MainActivity.

methods.name: navigateToMain
methods.description: Starts the MainActivity and finishes the SplashActivity after the splash duration.
